text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each farm's half-hourly power against ERA5 100 m wind speed, as a share of the top level of its fitted monotone curve. Blue shade: number of half-hours (darker is more, log scale). Orange line: median in 0.5 m/s bins. Orange band: 5% to 95% of the half-hours in each bin. Rows dropped by experiment 210's mask are left out.'
